collect.title: What We Collect
collect.body: When you make a reservation at Bobo's Farm, we collect your name, email address, and phone number. If you upload a payment screenshot to confirm your deposit, we store that image securely. We also use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language preference.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.body: We use your personal information to process and manage your reservations, communicate booking confirmations and reminders, verify deposit payments, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.body: Your data is stored securely in our database hosted on Supabase (AWS US-East-1). Payment screenshots are stored in secure cloud storage. We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us or through your account settings. You can update your profile, change your password, and manage notification preferences from the Settings page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at info@bobosfarm.com or call (516) 272-9999. Our address is 891 Albany Post Rd, New Paltz, NY 12561.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using the Bobo's Farm website and booking system, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

booking.title: Booking & Cancellation
booking.body: Reservations are confirmed once a deposit is received and verified by our team. Cancellations made 7 or more days before the reservation date are eligible for a full deposit refund. Cancellations made less than 7 days before the reservation date will result in forfeiture of the deposit. Please review our full cancellation policy for details.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.body: A deposit of $300 is required to secure your reservation. Deposits must be paid via Zelle within the specified time window (typically 24 hours for self-serve bookings, 48 hours for admin-assisted bookings). If payment is not received within this window, the reservation will be automatically cancelled and the date will be released.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Bobo's Farm provides a farm dining experience. We are not responsible for allergic reactions if dietary restrictions were not communicated in advance. Guests participate in outdoor farm activities at their own risk. Our total liability is limited to the amount of the deposit paid.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Ulster County, New York.

overview.title: Policy Overview
overview.body: We understand plans can change. Our cancellation policy is designed to be fair to both our guests and our team, who prepare fresh ingredients in advance for each reservation.

eligible.title: 7+ days before reservation: Full refund
eligible.desc: Cancel at least 7 days before your reservation date and receive a full refund of your $300 deposit.

nonEligible.title: Less than 7 days before reservation: Deposit forfeited
nonEligible.desc: Cancellations made within 7 days of the reservation date are non-refundable, as ingredients have already been ordered and preparation has begun.

howToCancel.title: How to Cancel
howToCancel.body: You can cancel your reservation through your

disputes.title: Disputes & Exceptions
disputes.body: If you believe an exception should be made (e.g., medical emergency, severe weather), please contact us at info@bobosfarm.com or call (516) 272-9999. We review each case individually and will do our best to accommodate reasonable requests.
